seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor: We’re Yonas and Daniel and we’re building StarSling ( https://starsling.dev ), fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that ship PRs to continuously improve your tests and workflows. Every CI job gets its own ephemeral sandbox on the fastest Zen 5 machines and NVMe Disk with unlimited concurrency so a burst of agent PRs all run at once. We’re different from other runners because ours come with agents that cut down your CI bill over time. PRs are generated through our CI harness, which runs an agent loop that’s tuned to improve your CI speed and reduce cost. Mastra now merges over 1,800 PRs a month and we got their slowest workflow from 29m 56s on GitHub-hosted runners down to 5m 06s (5.87x) on StarSling. We realized the true value of having an agent loop running on top of fast runners when our agents found an 11-month-old performance bottleneck in better-auth.
